nodes.speaker: Tech
nodes.text: Welcome to Smart Home HQ! Everything in here is connected. Lights, temperature, you name it.

nodes.speaker: Tech
text: Homecontrol is a smart home dashboard. It lets you monitor and control devices around the house from one place.
Lights, thermostat, sensors — all unified into a clean interface. Built with Next.js and running right here on the Pi.

nodes.speaker: Tech
nodes.text: The portal to Homecontrol is on the right side of the room. It requires owner access since it controls real devices.

nodes.speaker: Tech
nodes.text: Feel free to check out the monitors. Each one shows a different sensor feed. The portal is on the right when you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Tech
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Stay connected!
